BEFORE YOU GET IN TOUCH

A little clarity helps.

Have another question? Talk directly with the workshop.

Call +91 96553 33511
Does a repair request confirm my appointment?

No. Your message starts an enquiry. The workshop will confirm availability, timing and the next steps directly with you.

How much will the repair cost?

Ask the workshop about diagnosis charges, parts and an estimate for your appliance. Prices and warranty terms are not published here.

Can I ask about a home visit or pickup?

Yes. Call or message the workshop with your locality and appliance details to check whether a home visit or pickup is available for your request.

What information should I have ready?

Your appliance type, brand and model if known, a short description of the fault, and a way to reach you. Do not share passwords, payment information or private device contents in your enquiry.
